title: Open wicker weave of reeds over stakes
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of wicker: round weavers passing over and under round stakes in randing, double randing or over-two weaves, with open gaps in the albedo alpha, fibre streaks, rattan nodes and worn paint. Use for baskets, wicker chairs, hampers, screens and garden furniture.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python wicker_weave.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: 0 randing (over one stake, under one), 1 double randing (weavers in pairs), 2 over two and under two, stepping one stake per row.

parameters.name: stakes
parameters.meaning: Upright stakes across the tile; rounded up to keep the pattern repeating.

parameters.name: weavers
parameters.meaning: Weavers down the tile; rounded up to keep the pattern repeating.

parameters.name: stake_width
parameters.meaning: Stake diameter as a share of the stake spacing.

parameters.name: weaver_width
parameters.meaning: Weaver diameter as a share of the weaver spacing; below 1 light shows between weavers.

parameters.name: bulge
parameters.meaning: How far the weavers bend over and under the stakes.

parameters.name: fibres
parameters.meaning: Fibre streaks, tone differences and nodes along the reeds.

parameters.name: paint_wear
parameters.meaning: On painted presets, how much of the paint has worn through to the reed on high points.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Natural honey rattan in plain randing.

presets.name: white_painted
presets.description: White-painted wicker with the paint worn through on the high points.

presets.name: willow_twill
presets.description: Grey-brown willow, over two and under two, with wide gaps.

limits: Reeds are ideal round rods with a cosine bend around the stakes; they do not flatten where they cross, and stakes stay straight. Borders, rims, chair-caning hexagons and twined (pairing) weaves are out of scope. The gaps are an alpha cut-out at 0.5, so the material needs alpha scissor (set in the Godot template and the Blender builder); behind the gaps the albedo is a dark reed colour. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate that ignores the open gaps. Colours are artistic.
technique_references: Stake and weaver rods with whole counts on the torus
Over and under depths from a weave pattern, eased between stakes with a cosine
Visible surface as the higher of two rod cross-sections
Alpha coverage from the distance to the rod edge
Value-noise fibre streaks along each rod
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
